latin: De nulla re an existat potest quaerere aliquis artifex specialis.
translation: No practitioner of a particular science can inquire, of any thing, whether it exists.
translation_note: 'artifex specialis' is a practitioner of a particular art or science, as opposed to the metaphysician who considers being as such (farmer1998:14228).
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch2, from Latin at farmer1998:14228
not_established: No secondary scholarship discussing thesis 13.5 specifically was found in the corpus harvest; the attribution to Mohammed of Toledo rests on the 900 Conclusions' own section rubric, not on external confirmation.
